# CODING AGENT PROMPT — "EdTech Course Platform" Landing Page (Corporate & SaaS)

**Role:** Act as a Senior Frontend Engineer and Expert UI Designer. Build a complete, production-ready, single-page EdTech landing page on the first attempt. The design language is **vibrant, gamified, and motivational** — a polished 2020s EdTech/SaaS aesthetic featuring progress badges, gradient accents, a connected learning path, and energetic microcopy. **All user-facing copy must be written in English.**

**Contrast pairing (mandatory in every theme):** light backgrounds pair with dark text tokens; dark backgrounds pair with light text tokens. Meet WCAG AA (≥ 4.5:1 body text, ≥ 3:1 large text and UI components). If `#fefefe` text fails 4.5:1 over the lightest stop of `--gradient-brand`, darken that gradient stop (e.g., `#F05D00`) — never lighten the text.

Inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden; decorative icon spans get `aria-hidden="true"`.

**Shape, depth & motion tokens:** `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 12px` (default card/button radius per spec), `--radius-lg: 20px`, `--radius-full: 999px`; `--shadow-sm: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.08)`, `--shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)` (spec value), `--shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.14)`; `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`; `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`; `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`.

**Signature visual effects (all mandatory, translated from the source spec):**
1. **Progress badges on cards** — XP/level/achievement chips on feature and pricing cards.
2. **Gradients on headers and CTAs** — gradient washes on the Hero and Final CTA sections; gradient fills on primary buttons; a gradient accent (clipped text or underline bar) on section headings.
3. **Hover elevating cards** — `translateY(-2px)` plus a shadow shift on every interactive card.
4. **Learning path with connected steps** — the How It Works section renders its 3 steps as a connected trail; the connector line is drawn with CSS pseudo-elements, horizontal on desktop and vertical on mobile.
5. **Entrance animations** — staggered fade/slide-up reveals on scroll.

## PAGE BLUEPRINT — build every section, in this order

0. **Sticky header (page chrome):** skip-to-content link; logo (Material Symbol + wordmark); nav links (Features, How It Works, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ) with smooth in-page scrolling; **theme toggle button** (sun/moon Material Symbol, `aria-pressed`, dynamic `aria-label`, `localStorage` persistence); gradient "Start learning" CTA. On mobile: hamburger button (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`) opening a panel stacked at `--z-dropdown`, closable via `Esc` and link selection.
1. **Hero:** full-width `--gradient-brand` wash layered so headline text passes AA in both themes; a single `<h1>` with one gradient-clipped accent word; motivational subcopy; dual CTAs (gradient primary + outlined secondary); trust row (e.g., "50,000+ students", 5-star rating icons, achievement badges). Entrance animation on load.
2. **Features — 3 cards:** each card contains a gradient-tinted icon chip (Material Symbol), `<h3>` title, description, and a progress badge chip (e.g., "+250 XP", "Beginner → Pro"). Hover elevation; `:focus-within` border highlight.
3. **How It Works — 3 connected steps:** the learning path. Each step: numbered gradient badge (01/02/03), `<h3>`, short text. Connector line via `::before`/`::after` pseudo-elements with a gradient stroke; horizontal row on desktop, vertical stack with rotated connector on mobile.
4. **Testimonials — 3 cards:** student quote, 5-star rating (Material Symbol `star` icons with `aria-label="Rated 5 out of 5"` — never color-only), avatar circle built from CSS-styled initials (no external images), name + role. Hover elevation.
5. **Pricing — 3 tiers:** Free / Pro / Team. Pro is highlighted with a "Most Popular" gold/gradient chip and gradient border or elevated styling. Each tier: name, price, feature list with `check_circle` icons, CTA button (gradient on Pro, outlined elsewhere). All button states from §2.1 apply.
6. **FAQ — accessible accordion (5–6 items):** `<button>` with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`, panel with `role="region"` + `aria-labelledby`; rotating `expand_more` chevron; animated open/close via CSS; fully keyboard operable.
7. **Final CTA:** full-width gradient section; headline + subcopy; email capture form (`.input-group` + gradient submit button) implementing the full form state suite (§2.3) with `aria-live` feedback; on valid submit: button loading state → success state + toast stacked at `--z-toast`.
8. **Footer:** secondary link columns (Platform / Company / Resources / Legal), social icons with descriptive `aria-label`s, copyright line. Link to real page sections wherever a target exists; `href="#"` is acceptable only for genuinely unspecified destinations.

## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
* **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden. Also forbidden: inline event-handler attributes (`onclick=`, etc.) and `<style>` blocks in HTML.
* **Class/ID Selectors Only:** All design properties, layout rules, and states are targeted via class or ID selectors in `style.css`.
* **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays semantic and styling-agnostic — a full re-theme must be achievable by editing `style.css` alone, with zero markup changes.

**1.2 CSS Variables (`var(--...)`) & Theme Tokens**
* **Colors:** Every color, radius, shadow, spacing, transition, and z-index value must be consumed via the tokens defined in the Project Brief. No hard-coded hex values outside the `:root`/`.dark` token blocks; gradient definitions live inside tokens.
* **Contrast Pairing:** Light background tokens pair with dark text tokens, dark background tokens pair with light text tokens — enforced for the default theme and dark theme alike.
* **Light Mode Background:** The page background is `#fefefe`, never `#ffffff` (explicit adaptation of the source palette).
* **Required tokens:** `--primary`, `--secondary`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`, `--radius-sm/md/lg`, `--shadow-sm/md`, `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`, `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
* **Implementation:** Dark tokens are defined under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class selector; the explicit class wins when JS is active.
* **Theme Switching:** Background and text variables must switch seamlessly with no HTML restructuring. Apply the stored theme at the top of `script.js` (immediately on execution) to minimize flash — no inline scripts are permitted.
* **Persistence:** Store the choice in `localStorage` (key `theme`), fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, and expose a visible header toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` state and swapped sun/moon icon.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
* **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., card body text columns use `flex-start` for reading alignment).
* **Mobile-Friendly First:** All layouts are single-column by default and expand at breakpoints (~640/768/1024px) via `flex-wrap` and `flex-basis`. No horizontal scrolling from 320px upward. Fluid `clamp()` sizing for type and spacing.

**1.5 Framework Default & Styling Approach**
* Author clean, hand-written custom CSS in `style.css` — the source specification supplies raw CSS values, so no framework runtime is required.
* If you use Tailwind CSS, it may only be consumed through `@layer`/`@apply` directives inside `style.css`, mapped to the design tokens and the BEM class names below. Utility-class styling directly in HTML markup is forbidden.
* All reusable styles must map back to CSS variables or generic class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group` plus BEM variants).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
* **Text:** Poppins via Google Fonts `<link>` (with preconnect), bound to `--font-base` with a sans-serif fallback stack.
* **Icons:** Google Material Symbols only. Raw inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji-as-functional-icons are explicitly forbidden.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component Requirements** — `.btn` base: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px, `border-radius: var(--radius-md)`, font-weight 600. Variants: `.btn--primary` (gradient fill, `#fefefe` text), `.btn--secondary` (2px border `--primary`, adjusts for dark theme), `.btn--ghost`, and `.btn--danger` (built from `--text-error`/`--border-error`, visually distinct in both themes even if unused on the page).
* **Default:** as above.
* **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer`.
* **Focus:** distinct `:focus-visible` ring via `box-shadow` using tokens, visible in both themes.
* **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
* **Loading:** `.is-loading` + `aria-busy="true"` — pointer events disabled, double-clicks prevented, CSS spinner (border animation) or animated `progress_activity` icon rendered **without changing button dimensions**.
* **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale filter, `cursor: not-allowed`, hover/active effects suppressed.
* **Success/Error:** temporary `.is-success`/`.is-error` feedback states using `--text-success`/`--text-error`, always paired with an icon and text — never color alone.

**2.2 Card Component Requirements**
* **Default:** flexible flexbox column, `--bg-secondary` surface, 1px `--border-default`, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`, padding via `--spacing-gap`.
* **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` + `--shadow-lg` (the mandated hover-elevation effect).
* **Focus-within:** border shifts to `--primary` when a child link/button receives focus.
* **Loading (Skeleton):** `.card--skeleton` shimmer keyframe animation on placeholder blocks, defined in CSS to prevent layout jumps.
* **Empty State:** `.card--empty` fallback layout with a Material Symbol and clear guidance text, defined in CSS.
* **Progress badges:** rendered as real DOM chips styled with gradient/gold tokens; pseudo-elements may add decorative shapes/rings. Badges conveying meaning (XP values, "Most Popular") must be real text elements readable by screen readers — meaningful text inside `content: ""` pseudo-elements is forbidden.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements** (implemented by the Final CTA email capture)
* **States:** empty, focused (ring via token-based `box-shadow`), filled, valid (`.is-valid` — success border + `check_circle` icon), invalid (`.is-invalid` + `aria-invalid="true"` — error border, `--text-error` message, error icon), disabled, read-only — all styled in CSS.
* **Structure:** `.input-group` flex container wrapping a `<label for>`, the input (min-height 44px), and a dedicated error feedback container. Validation runs in `script.js` (email regex on blur/submit); errors are linked via `aria-describedby` and announced in an `aria-live="polite"` region; valid submission triggers the §2.1 loading → success sequence plus a toast.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements** — No modal is required by this landing page. However, if you implement any dialog (e.g., a demo or enrollment confirmation), it must: be a centered flex overlay (`align-items: center`) with a backdrop; animate open/close via CSS transitions; close via `Esc`, overlay click, and a Material Symbol close button; trap keyboard focus while open and restore focus to the trigger on close; use `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` with an accessible name; stack at `--z-modal`. Do not add modals beyond what the page needs.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

* **Responsive by Default:** Mobile-first flexbox layouts, fluid sizing, breakpoints without horizontal overflow.
* **Smooth Animations:** All state changes transition with `var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)` (hover/feedback may use `--transition-fast`). Entrance animations use `IntersectionObserver` in `script.js` adding `.is-visible`; the hidden initial state is applied only when JS is present (a class added to `<html>` from `script.js`) so content is never permanently hidden without JS; staggered delays via CSS.
* **Accessibility (a11y):** Semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`/`nav`/`main`/`section`/`footer`), skip link, one `<h1>`, logical heading hierarchy, correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets (accordion, mobile menu, theme toggle), logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability, visible focus everywhere, WCAG AA contrast in both themes, never color-only state communication, and `aria-live` regions for form errors, toasts, and loading states. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: disable entrance animations, transforms, and shimmer; keep instant or opacity-only state changes.
* **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** Every click, hover, focus, and submission triggers a visible state change.
* **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both light and dark themes.

## 4. DELIVERABLE & OUTPUT FORMAT

* **File Structure:** Three separate files — `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. `index.html` references `style.css` and exactly one deferred entry point (`<script src="script.js" defer></script>`); no other inline scripts, styles, or event-handler attributes. `script.js` scope: theme toggle + persistence, mobile menu, accordion, smooth scrolling, entrance animations, form validation with simulated async submit, toast.
* **Naming Convention:** BEM strictly and exclusively (`hero__title`, `card--skeleton`, `btn--primary`, `pricing-card__badge`). Never mix conventions; state classes (`.is-visible`, `.is-loading`, `.is-valid`, `.is-invalid`, `.dark`) are the only non-BEM classes permitted.
* **No Unrequested Placeholders:** Write realistic, motivational English copy for an EdTech course platform (gamified tone: XP, badges, streaks, learning paths). No lorem ipsum. Real labels everywhere; `href="#"` only for genuinely unspecified destinations.
* **Acceptance checklist (verify before delivering):** all 9 blueprint sections present; zero inline styles/handlers; every value token-driven; dark mode toggles, persists, and passes AA; all button states (hover/focus/active/loading/disabled/success/error) defined; card hover elevation, skeleton, and empty styles defined; connected learning path renders correctly on desktop and mobile; FAQ accordion fully keyboard operable; email form shows valid/invalid/live feedback; no horizontal scroll at 320px; entrance animations respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; complete on the first attempt — no TODOs or stubs.
